examples.note: The patient presents with a history of cystic fibrosis and rheumatoid arthritis. They report coughing up blood and have a chronic cough that produces colored or more abundant sputum than usual. The patient also has a history of Crohn’s disease and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). They have a history of asthma and have previously required the use of a bronchodilator. No travel outside the country in the last four weeks is reported.
